h1: Land Rover Engine Compatibility & Application Matching
lede: We verify every engine against your exact Land Rover's VIN, chassis code, model year, and ECU calibration. No guesswork, no “should fit” — just the right engine, the first time.

blocks.html: Engine compatibility and application matching is the professional process of determining which engines can be correctly fitted to your specific Land Rover. It is not simply looking at an engine code — it's a systematic cross-reference of your vehicle's VIN, chassis code, model year, market specification, and existing ECU calibration against the official Land Rover parts catalogue (TOPIx).

items: **Engine block and cylinder head** — correct casting, bore, and deck height
**Timing components** — chain/belt spec, tensioner fitment, cam profiles
**Ancillary fitment** — alternator, power steering pump, A/C compressor mounting points (often model-specific, not engine-family-specific)
**Transmission interface** — bellhousing pattern and flywheel/flexplate compatibility
**ECU calibration** — power output variant, emission class, and injector/turbo matching

blocks.html: For used engines, we confirm the exact engine code from the donor vehicle's VIN before any installation work begins. This avoids the common problem of buying a “compatible” engine that turns out to be the wrong power variant or from a different model year with different ancillaries.

steps.title: VIN & Registration Submission
steps.body: You provide your registration or VIN. We use this to identify your exact model, chassis code, and market specification.

steps.title: TOPIx Catalogue Cross-Reference
steps.body: We check your VIN against the official Land Rover parts catalogue to confirm the original engine code, ancillaries, and transmission fitment.

steps.title: ECU Calibration & Power Variant Check
steps.body: We verify the ECU calibration and power output variant (e.g., D150 vs D200) to ensure the replacement or rebuilt engine matches your vehicle's emissions and drivability.

steps.title: Ancillary & Transmission Compatibility
steps.body: We check mounting points for alternator, A/C, and power steering, plus bellhousing pattern and flywheel compatibility.

steps.title: Compatibility Sign-Off
steps.body: You receive a full compatibility report confirming the exact engine that should be fitted to your vehicle, with no “should fit” caveats.

sections.heading: Why Choose Us for Engine Matching

items: **Official TOPIx access** — we use the same Land Rover parts catalogue as main dealers.
**VIN-based matching** — every check starts with your vehicle's unique VIN, not a guessed engine code.
**Ancillary-specific verification** — we don't assume ancillaries transfer; we check every mounting point.
**ECU calibration awareness** — we know that the same engine code can have different power outputs and emission classes across model years.
**Transmission interface check** — we verify bellhousing pattern and flywheel compatibility, so your gearbox fits.

steps.title: 1. The same engine code isn't always the same engine
steps.body: The AJ200D Ingenium diesel is fitted to the Discovery Sport, Evoque, Velar, and Defender — but each application has different ancillaries, ECU calibrations, and sometimes different transmission bellhousings. We don't assume.

steps.title: 2. Platform sharing adds complexity
steps.body: Some Land Rover models share platforms with other JLR vehicles (e.g., Velar L560 shares its D7a aluminium platform with Jaguar F-Pace, XF, and XE). This means some underbody components and engine bay layouts are shared, but not everything — we check every interface.

steps.title: 3. Used engines need the same matching
steps.body: For used engines, we confirm the exact engine code from the donor vehicle's VIN before installation. A “compatible” engine from a different year or model often has different ancillary mounts or ECU pins.

items.q: Do I need engine matching if I'm just having my engine rebuilt?
items.a: Yes — if your engine needs replacement components (block, head, ancillaries) or if you're switching to a different power variant, we verify compatibility against your VIN. Even for a like-for-like rebuild, we confirm the correct part numbers for timing components, gaskets, and seals.

items.q: Can you match an engine from a different Land Rover model?
items.a: Sometimes, but not always. We check the official TOPIx catalogue to see if the engine code was ever factory-fitted to your model. If it wasn't, we don't recommend it — the ancillaries, ECU, or transmission may not fit correctly.

items.q: What information do I need to provide?
items.a: Your registration or full VIN. We use this to check the official Land Rover parts catalogue and confirm the exact engine code, power variant, ancillaries, and transmission interface for your specific vehicle.

items.q: Is engine matching included in a rebuild quote?
items.a: Yes — for any full rebuild or replacement, we include a complete compatibility check as part of the quotation. If you just need a standalone match check (e.g., for a used engine you've found), the starting price is £140.
